remarks: Welcome to 12 Beach Drive in the heart of Darien, CT, where casual beach elegance meets easy living. This stunning Colonial home boasts 3/4 bedrooms and 3 full baths within its approximately 2700 square feet, perfectly situated on a generous .38 acre lot. Step inside to discover a fun open concept layout, flooded with natural light, featuring a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The new kitchen and baths, along with freshly painted interiors, lend a fresh and inviting ambiance to the home. Indulge in waterfront living at its finest. The Noroton Manor Association provides water access and private tennis courts. The continuous sidewalks lead to the elementary school and public beach where you'll find a variety of recreational activities including paddle, tennis, junior sailing, walking paths, playground, and a seasonal beach pavilion with food service. Don't miss the opportunity to make this coastal retreat your own and enjoy the traditions and camaraderie of the Noroton Manor neighborhood. With the redevelopment at the Darien Commons and The Corbin District, Darien is THE town everyone is talking about! Experience the best of coastal living in Darien!
